title: Stacy M NDE 4142
content: It was springtime and my friend Clare who owned the horse we rode was warming up for a show at our barn. Clare asked me if I wanted to warm up too so I said sure. We were at the far end of the field and I asked my friend Kate to hold Stuart (the horse) while I got on. She held the reins and I put my foot in the stirrup, grabbed his mane, and got myself part of the way up in the saddle. This part of my story is where the NDE I believe took place. Stuart bolted and dragged me down the field, as my foot was caught in the stirrup. When I came free, he trampled my leg and I had a grand mal seizure. I have no history of seizure prior to this. I had a sense of nothingness. I know that I SAW darkness. I know I felt like I was lying on the ground and looking up into darkness. There was a form that felt loving, a female who was looking over my body. (I just started to tear up feeling this story again.) 'She' was hovering it felt above me. She had an outline and it felt like her long wavy blond hair hung down too. Next, I felt being in the ambulance. I thought everything in the ambulance was bathed in a minty, misty, green glow of a light. I think I was concerned. Next, I was in the children's hospital and I know I was awake and different than thinking I was awake. My mom was there and I repeatedly started asking her what color she was wearing, if she was wearing purple pants.

arrival.other_being_detail: A loving female form hovering above her body, with an outline and long wavy blond hair hanging down.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Dragged by a horse with foot caught in stirrup; horse trampled her leg; followed by a grand mal seizure (no prior seizure history).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Reported darkness/nothingness; then perception of ambulance bathed in minty, misty green light; then being awake in children's hospital asking mother about clothing color.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Darkness/nothingness with a loving female presence over her body, then awareness of being in an ambulance, then in a children's hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived the ambulance interior as bathed in a minty, misty green glow; in hospital repeatedly asked her mother what color she was wearing and whether she had purple pants.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I had a sense of nothingness. I know that I SAW darkness.”; “There was a form that felt loving, a female who was looking over my body.”; “I thought everything in the ambulance was bathed in a minty, misty, green glow of a light.”
